title: Great product!!
text: Great product!!. I like using cutting boards. I have certain ones for different things to cut. . I always had a hard time finding the right size sometimes but the teal blue one in this set is the perfect length and size to cut up a whole romaine lettuce heart !! That is exactly what I wanted to find. The thickness is great and its not heavy at all. I love that it has a nice handle/ hole cut for your hand. Easier to store because of that. The little one (grey) is perfect for chopping things like a tomatoe.. Or hard boiled egg. I def recommend this set of cutting boards.. It doesnt get cutting groves from sharp knives either..good sturdy material
